property_summary: For any admissible input where the transfer does not revert, the reference contract always returns true, while the mutant returns false.
For any input where the loop calls succeed (no revert), the reference always returns true, but the mutant returns false.

A call to transfer(...) with exactly one recipient succeeds in the reference but reverts in the buggy version; thus the reference always returns true for any non-empty _tos array, while the mutant returns false/reverts for a single-element _tos.

If the call to caddress succeeds for every recipient in the _tos array then the reference contract returns true on any call with a non-empty _tos array; the mutant reverts when _tos has exactly one element even if the caddress call would have succeeded.
Calling transfer with an empty _tos array must revert; the mutant allows it to succeed.
Correct C reverts the entire transfer if any sub-call fails, while the mutant silently ignores failures and returns true; thus the invariant: if at least one sub-call reverts, transfer must revert.
